<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|“That is my title, and now my name. Eldest I am, and Eldest I am called, until my life leaves me and another takes up the title.”}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|— ''House of Blades'', chapter 9}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Eldest Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The Eldest, also known as Eldest [[Nye]] or [[Ka’nie’ka]], is the leader of [[the Nye]], a race of beings that appear as bundles of cloth or men wrapped in black fabric. Having lived for centuries, the Eldest is a figure of great age and power who seeks to restore [[the House]] of [[Valinhall]] to its former glory. This ambition involves recovering the eight missing [[Dragon's Fang|Dragon’s Fangs]], recruiting students, gathering powerful objects from other Territories, and securing human servants to rebuild [[the House]]'s strength. The Eldest is driven by a fear of fading into nothingness, as [[the Nye]] once nearly lost their power entirely. The Eldest possesses unique abilities, including the capacity to move through shadows to travel instantly between pools of darkness and the ability to see much of what occurs within [[the House]]. While many [[Nye]] are bound to [[the House]], the Eldest's status allows him greater freedom and influence. He is capable of manipulating the essence of his kind and can communicate with the intelligent guardians of [[Valinhall]]. Despite a raspy, grating voice and a sometimes cruel or manipulative demeanor, he has formed pacts with individuals like the son of [[Kalman]], even providing a cloak as a mark of their agreement. He serves a master and remains deeply connected to the history and survival of his people.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|This faded [[Nye]] wears stormcloud gray robes and a black cloak that serves as a mark of their bargain. The character has a void for a face and voluminous sleeves that hide their hands. Shorter than most [[Nye]], they reach only to [[Simon]]'s shoulder and glide over tiles rather than walking.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The Eldest is motivated by the desire to expand the [[Territory]] and restore [[Valinhall]] at any cost. They are a calculating figure who views certain humans as valuable pieces and seeks to test the potential of others. While they can be pleased by new additions to [[the House]], they also harbor a fear of losing power and may feel anger toward [[Simon]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The Eldest tests the potential of [[Andra Agnos|Andra]] and assigns tasks to [[Simon]], a person who fears him. He also interacts with [[Kai]] by speaking to him and waiting for him in the forge. Additionally, he has a long-standing connection with [[Valin]] and is contemplating the [[Fate|fate]] of [[Indirial]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The Eldest moves with stealth and grace, possessing the power to materialize out of [[Shadow|shadow]]. They are capable of performing miracles and utilize a resurrection technique. Additionally, they hold [[Mithra]] and have the physical strength to stop [[Simon]].}}
